info.title: ExeMem Cloud API
info.description: Design-only. Product: fetch/push/manage with {database_id,intent,args}. Account: {intent,args} without database_id, no protocol header. Maintenance: DEV snapshot-proof. Batching max 90. Live home: cloud_backup_protocol/cloud-api.openapi.json.

post.description: Identity, keys, payments. No database_id. No protocol header (Decision 5/18). Host: ExeMem HTTP API (today /api/auth/* and /api/developer/* on the same base URL). enroll_*/login_* must not be batched.
Product reads. Envelope with database_id. Protocol header required.
Operational non-database calls. DEV snapshot-proof only today. Protocol header required. x-lastdb-environment:dev.
Product writes. Dual-auth open question for create/file; see design doc.

CloudProtocol.name: X-LastDB-Cloud-Protocol
CloudProtocol.description: Required on fetch/push/manage/maintenance. Not on account.
